checks.message: SITE/KEY_AREA geometry is explicitly provisional_constraint with official_boundary=false; it supports intake, reference design, visualization and temporary recalculation only. Replace official polygons before statutory or professional use.
All three required key areas remain provisional reference geometries; announced areas and recalculated values are disclosed in the proposal and evidence files.
Six participant-controlled land-use polygons still cover the submitted provisional site without overlap and retain allowed land_use_code values.
Design layers are retained inside the submitted site; prototype passport nodes add conceptual one-to-one rooms, courtyards, service porches, and repair/reuse points.
Core areas and ratios remain synchronized with projected GeoJSON; lifecycle metrics distinguish known geometry counts from unknown operating outcomes.
Primary and English visual pages are offline, local-image-only, static HTML with synchronized metric attributes and no remote or active content.

Chinese and English drawing sets contain local evidence figures, lifecycle and MAKE-TRANSLATE-USE diagrams, role-specific control fields, a public stop transition, prototype passport, delivery register, and phasing content.
The 13 required chapters cite registered sources, standards, depth items, readable geometry layers, and known metrics; matrices cover announcement and agent taskbook requirements.
Complete English narrative and paired offline display material are provided; manifest translation links are refreshed after final generation.
